links.comparator_used: Same three LLMs (DeepSeek-V3, Qwen 2.5-72B-Instruct, GPT-3.5-turbo) in non-RAG mode, without guideline retrieval
links.outcome: Expert-rated decision accuracy, logical coherence and professional readability (Likert), plus ROUGE-L F1 and BERTScore F1 against expert-drafted standard restorative reports, for 30 post-endodontic restoration cases
links.effect: All models improved on all evaluation metrics in RAG mode versus non-RAG mode, with statistically significant differences. Highest BERTScore F1 in RAG mode was 0.91 (DeepSeek-V3). Significant model-by-RAG interactions for decision accuracy (χ2=10.11) and ROUGE-L F1 (χ2=8.57), so the size of the gain differed by model.
links.quote: The RAG-based CDSS-RAG-Pro improves the accuracy and interpretability of general-purpose LLM in decision-making for post-endodontic tooth restoration.
